name: Boogeyman Under the Bed (Kobold Rogue 2)
body:
Kobold Rogue 2
CR 1/2

Male kobold rogue 2
LE Small humanoid (reptilian)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+2 armor, +3 Dex, +1 natural, +1 size)
hp 12 (2d8)
Fort +0, Ref +6, Will +1
Defensive Abilities evasion
Weakness light sensitivity

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee dagger +2 (1d3) or mwk shortsword +3 (1d4)
Ranged dagger +5 (1d3/19–20)
Special Attacks sneak attack +1d6

TACTICS

Before Combat If aware of the PCs, he hides under the bed, gaining total cover. The PCs can make opposed Perception checks to hear him before he strikes, allowing them to act in the surprise round.

During Combat He uses the cramped space to his advantage whenever possible, preventing others from entering the room. He focuses all of his attacks on the PC with the least armor first.

Morale If dropped to 3 or fewer hit points, he attempts to flee through a hole in the wall leading into the hallway. This hole is 5 feet above the bed, requiring a single DC 10 Climb check to scale. Once outside, he attempts to flee to warn other kobolds below.

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 17, Con 11, Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 8
Base Atk +1; CMB +0; CMD 13
Feats Improved Initiative
Skills Acrobatics +6, Bluff +4, Climb +3, Craft (Traps) +5, Disable Device +5, Escape Artist +1, Perception +8, Sense Motive +6, Stealth +10, Survival +3
Languages Draconic
SQ fast getaway, trapfinding
Combat Gear potion of cure light wounds; Other Gear daggers (4), masterwork shortsword, leather armor, thieves’ tools
